name: Rome
headline: Buildings that already look expensive.
summary: Four hotels at $150 or under for 10–11 November 2026, plus Hotel Locarno as the splurge.
intro: The Rome edit is four hotels whose Booking.com rate for 10–11 November 2026, two adults, was $150 or under, each with a score of 8.5 or higher. They include a restored monastery on Via Veneto, a suite hotel in Tiburtino, and two smaller houses in Prati and on Via Calabria. Hotel Locarno, which calls itself a five-star and dates its opening to 1925, is the splurge.
